I will lower confidence in desk_b1 for Marisol's items.", "fork": {"beliefs": "BELIEFS: Household routines are looser than assumed. 
1. Personal items (keys, wallet, phone, water_bottle) are often ON_PERSON during the day, but at night (00:00-07:00) they are distributed across nightstands (nightstand_b1, nightstand_b2, nightstand_b3) with low certainty for any single item. 
2. Marisol (resident_1, bedroom_1) keeps book_marisol and glasses_marisol on nightstand_b1 at night. 
3. Kitchen items (mug_marisol, mug_talia, plate_shared_1, bowl_shared_1) are used at kitchen_table_k1 or counter_k1 and returned to cupboard_k1 or dish_rack_k1. 
4. Bedroom items (laptop_talia, notebook_talia, headphones_talia) are on desk_b2 or bed_b2. 
5. Living room items (remote_shared_1, gaming_controller_shared_1) are on coffee_table_l1 or tv_stand_l1. 
6. Residents: resident_1 (Marisol) is in bedroom_1, resident_2 (Nico) in bedroom_2, resident_3 (Talia) in bedroom_3. 
7. Time-based: 00:00-07:00 residents in bedrooms. 07:00-18:00 residents in living/kitchen. 18:00-22:00 residents in living/kitchen. 22:00-00:00 residents in bedrooms. 
8. Misplacement is common (~20%). If an object is not in its primary home spot, it is likely ON_PERSON of the owner or in a secondary nearby receptacle. 
9. Shared items (umbrella_shared_1, dog_leash_shared_1) are in entry_table_e1 or entry_hook_e1. 
10. Bathroom items (towel_marisol, hairbrush_marisol) are in bathroom_shelf_ba1 or towel_rack_ba1. 
11. Laundry (laundry_basket_shared_1) is in bedroom_1 or living. 
12. Medication (medication_bottle_marisol) is in nightstand_b1. 
13. Charging (charger_marisol, charger_nico) is in nightstand_b1 or nightstand_b2, not desk_b1. 
Why: The look at desk_b1 revealed it was empty, contradicting the assumption that chargers are stored there.
